name: contentrevision
sql:
CREATE TABLE contentrevision (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	revision VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	approval_status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	registered_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_content_revision UNIQUE (content_key, revision)
)

name: schemamigration
sql:
CREATE TABLE schemamigration (
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	checksum VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	applied_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (version)
)

name: contentsectionprogress
sql:
CREATE TABLE contentsectionprogress (
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content_revision_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	section_slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	completed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	first_viewed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_viewed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (topic_id, content_revision_id, section_slug), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(content_revision_id) REFERENCES contentrevision (id)
)

name: topiccontentbinding
sql:
CREATE TABLE topiccontentbinding (
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content_revision_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	legacy_progress_compatible BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	coverage_note VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (topic_id, content_revision_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_topic_content_order UNIQUE (topic_id, order_index), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(content_revision_id) REFERENCES contentrevision (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id)
)

name: arenatopicbinding
sql:
CREATE TABLE arenatopicbinding (
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	problem_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	content_revision_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER, 
	rationale VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (curriculum_id, problem_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(problem_key) REFERENCES arenaproblem ("key"), 
	FOREIGN KEY(content_revision_id) REFERENCES contentrevision (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: courseexercisebinding
sql:
CREATE TABLE courseexercisebinding (
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content_revision_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	exercise_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	exercise_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (topic_id, content_revision_id, exercise_key), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_registry_exercise UNIQUE (exercise_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(content_revision_id) REFERENCES contentrevision (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(exercise_id) REFERENCES exercise (id)
)
